definition: Unverified but widely circulated survival information passed orally or through low-bandwidth Diaspora nodes among Shelf residents — tips on which Ferrogate checkpoints are bribable, which food aid is contaminated, which ELFs are safe to negotiate with. Treated as sacred knowledge by those who depend on it.
origin: Shelf community oral tradition, borrowing religious framing as ironic self-awareness
usage: Exclusively Tier 1 and Shelf communities; using the term outside those contexts reads as mockery
example: Shelf gospel said the Carrion drop point on Pier 9 was clean, and so far the shelf gospel had never lied to Okonkwo.
